_comment: Wikipedia knowledge cards - the first route served by the Go backend rather than Laravel. Kept as its own route (not folded into teezer-public) precisely because it has a different upstream: if the Go service is down, only this route's health check fails and only the knowledge card disappears, while every Laravel route carries on. Priority is above teezer-public so the more specific /api/v1/knowledge path wins over that route's broader patterns.
name: teezer-knowledge
desc: Wikipedia knowledge card - Go upstream, heavily cached

limit-count._comment: Edge ceiling, deliberately above the Go handler's own 30/min per IP so the application limit is the one that normally applies and returns a useful JSON body. This exists to shed a flood before it reaches the process at all.
limit-count.rejected_msg: Too many requests. Please slow down and try again shortly.
